'''Central Sector''' was a district in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Amma]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bacrana/Legends|Bacrana]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], a large riot against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces occurred in the area, mainly around [[Central Sector Square]].
